datum.angles: a is clockwise degrees on top-view XY, local vector (0,−1) points to nominal USB on controller at a=0. x/y are footprint origins unless specified.
datum.outline: Counterclockwise or clockwise simple polygon in XY with implicit closing segment. Same outline in PCB and case.
